title: Staff names in Google reviews: a study-to-policy evidence audit

source.title: Gone in 7 Days: the Google review deletion study
source.scope: Selected seven-sector panel in the US and Europe excluding the UK. No Canadian cohort. Deletion means absence from successive complete daily listings, not a verified reason or a provider outcome.
source.reuse: The public landing page authorises reuse of charts and numbers with credit to Reviewflowz and Cartelis and a link. Raw report, raw reviews and source artwork are not republished here.

policy.note: Directing review content, including requests that identify a staff member, is distinct from a customer independently naming a person. Other content/privacy rules can still apply. The study does not observe the request that produced a review.

rate_rows: Same business, same age, same length (main test)
Same, on the cleaned study base
Reviews under 30 days old, staff-like name
Inside the four purged pest-control chains
Same industry, region, size and pace
flow_time_bases: Gains: preceding twelve months. Losses: observed two-week deletions scaled to a year. These are rounded group averages, not a fully observed annual cohort or cohort retention probability.
model_notes: Review-level comparisons and business-level regressions are distinct estimands with overlapping source data. We do not pool them, run a new significance/equivalence test or infer causal effects. Source group-boundary labels are preserved without redefining exact endpoints.
